input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Section 26 selects California law and Section 27 fixes an exclusive forum in the state or federal courts located in San Luis Obispo County, California, with consent to jurisdiction and waiver of forum objections. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the Agreement. California law with corresponding California courts sits squarely at the GOVLAW fallback position (both fallback elements are satisfied on their material terms), so we accept it and do not redline. It is short of the preferred New York law / New York County courts position only in the choice of accepted jurisdiction, which is a noted preference rather than a deviation; the intra-California county (San Luis Obispo, Vendor-convenient) is likewise a commercial point we would raise only if the negotiation is otherwise open.
